Doctor: 'Simple things might be wax... impacted wax... which can lead to muffled hearing... It might be that there's a problem inside the drum or the balance system within the ear.' This reflects a differential of wax impaction and tympanic/vestibular causes.

For that we need to have a look inside the eardrum... just have a quick look down the ear, figure out whether there's a physical blockage or whether there's something else going on.' This is an otoscopic exam to exclude blockage and assess the drum/middle ear.

Doctor: 'I'll send a message to our admin team, I'll ask them to slot you into one of our clinics in that time frame.' indicating administrative staff will arrange the appointment.
